name: Goodreads: Shelf / Genre Top Books
summary: List the most-popular books on a Goodreads shelf/genre (e.g. parenting, self-help, philosophy), one page of 50 per run. Returns title, author, URL, average rating, ratings count, and publication year.
description: Opens /shelf/show/<shelf>?page=<start_page> (popularity-ranked) and reads the classic server-rendered listing (a.bookTitle / a.authorName / .greyText), 50 books per page; pass start_page for the next page. This is the discovery entry point for 'top books in a field' — feed each book_url into goodreads/book, goodreads/reviews, or goodreads/similar.

shelf.description: Shelf / genre slug as it appears in /shelf/show/<slug>, e.g. 'parenting', 'self-help', 'philosophy', 'psychology', 'business'. Multi-word shelves use hyphens.

start_page.description: Shelf page to read (1-based, 50 books per page). Default 1 (the top 50); start_page=2 returns books 51-100.

inputs.script: const norm=(s)=>(s||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();const origin=location.origin;const cleanArg=(v)=>{const t=String(v==null?'':v).trim();return /^\{[a-zA-Z0-9_]+\}$/.test(t)?'':t;};const cleanPath=(h)=>{const m=(h||'').match(/\/book\/show\/[^?#]+/);return m?m[0]:'';};const shelfArg=cleanArg(arg0);const page=Math.min(Math.max(parseInt(cleanArg(arg1)||'1',10)||1,1),25);const books=[];const seen=new Set();for(const a of document.querySelectorAll('a.bookTitle')){const cont=a.closest('.elementList')||a.parentElement||document;const path=cleanPath(a.getAttribute('href'));if(!path||seen.has(path))continue;seen.add(path);const author=norm(cont.querySelector('a.authorName')?.textContent);const grey=norm(cont.querySelector('.greyText.smallText')?.textContent);const rm=grey.match(/avg rating ([\d.]+)/i);const cm=grey.match(/([\d,]+) ratings?/i);const pm=grey.match(/published (\d{4})/i);books.push({title:norm(a.textContent),author:author||'N/A',book_url:origin+path,avg_rating:rm?rm[1]:'N/A',ratings_count:cm?cm[1].replace(/,/g,''):'N/A',published:pm?pm[1]:'N/A'});}const shelfName=shelfArg||(location.pathname.match(/\/shelf\/show\/([^/?#]+)/)||[])[1]||'N/A';return {shelf:shelfName,page,count:books.length,books};

steps.name: Read the books the shelf page shows

help.summary: Popularity-ranked book list for a Goodreads shelf/genre, one page of 50 per run.

parameters.shelf: Shelf/genre slug from /shelf/show/<slug> (e.g. parenting, self-help, philosophy).

examples.command: rzn-browser run goodreads shelf --param shelf="self-help" --param start_page="2"

returns: Object: { shelf, page, count, books: [{ title, author, book_url, avg_rating, ratings_count, published }] }. Books are ordered by Goodreads' shelf popularity. Feed book_url into goodreads/book, goodreads/reviews, or goodreads/similar.
notes: Shelves are server-rendered classic pages; each run opens one ?page=<n> and makes no request of its own.
Results are deduplicated by book URL within the page.
Shelf popularity ranking is Goodreads' own (how many users shelved the book), a good proxy for 'top books in a field'.
